title: AeroTopo — 2308 Question Developer Simulation
subtitle: One interview question per lesson, with cumulative developer actions and the real AeroTopo project as the full-code reference.

books.title: Java Foundations & Enterprise Context
books.subtitle: Start with the Java platform, IntelliJ workflow, JDK, build tooling, and enterprise-development context.

chapters.title: 1: Java Enterprise Context & Tooling
chapters.subtitle: Establish Java enterprise-development context, ecosystem evolution, Lombok, Spring Boot development setup, and the core tools used by a Java developer.

chapters.title: 2: IDE Choice, IntelliJ & Productivity
chapters.subtitle: Keep the complete IDE sequence together: editor choice, project-standard IntelliJ usage, keyboard productivity, and translation of familiar STS shortcut concepts into the IntelliJ-only workflow.

chapters.title: 3: JVM, JDK, JRE & Java Execution
chapters.subtitle: Trace platform independence, multiple JDK installations, JVM internals, Hello World execution, and the distinct responsibilities of JDK, JRE, and JVM.

chapters.title: 4: Java main() Method
chapters.subtitle: Treat the complete main-method sequence as one topic: signature terms, overloading, static/public requirements, hiding versus overriding, and JVM selection of the launch entry point.

chapters.title: 5: Java Types, References & Parameter Semantics
chapters.subtitle: Connect type casting, static state, conversions, Java references versus pointers, primitive nullability, conversion failures, instanceof, and Java pass-by-value semantics.

chapters.title: 6: System.exit() & JVM Shutdown
chapters.subtitle: Keep process termination together: System.exit behavior, JVM shutdown hooks and sequencing, exit statuses, and whether explicit process termination belongs in the AeroTopo service.

chapters.title: 7: Project Methodology
chapters.subtitle: Ground the Agile-versus-Waterfall answer in AeroTopo's documented development, review, deployment, rollback, experimentation, and evidence-driven architecture practices.

chapters.title: 8: Array Algorithms
chapters.subtitle: Keep the contiguous array-problem sequence together: uniqueness, merge-and-sort, binary partitioning, moving zeros, one-loop sorting, and in-place duplicate removal for sorted arrays.

chapters.title: 9: Strings, Mutable Text & String Algorithms
chapters.subtitle: Keep the complete String sequence together: password memory handling, String Pool trade-offs, StringBuilder versus StringBuffer, reversal, concatenation internals, anagram grouping, manual substring search, first-unique characters, run expansion, and longest-palindrome logic.

chapters.title: 10: OOP Foundations, Classes, Objects & Object Lifecycle
chapters.subtitle: Build the complete OOP foundation from object creation and Java's mixed primitive/object model through classes, objects, lifecycle, reuse, abstraction, encapsulation, relationships, and the role OOP plays in AeroTopo and enterprise development.

chapters.title: 11: Constructors & Object Initialization
chapters.subtitle: Keep the constructor sequence together: constructor purpose, access, overloading, chaining rules, inheritance boundaries, legal modifiers, return behavior, missing no-arg construction, and framework-oriented no-argument constructors.

chapters.title: 12: Packages, Imports, Access Control & Encapsulation
chapters.subtitle: Connect package naming and structure with imports, top-level and member visibility, encapsulated state, getters versus controlled mutation, package use cases, and name-collision resolution across namespaces.

chapters.title: 13: Static Initialization, final & static Semantics
chapters.subtitle: Trace static blocks, class initialization, final variables/methods/classes, effective finality and immutability, initialization failures, static method binding and hiding, instance access from static context, and real AeroTopo uses of final and static members.

chapter_policy.lookahead_rule: Inspect enough upcoming source questions to identify the genuine topic transition before closing or creating a chapter.
chapter_policy.continuation_rule: If the requested batch ends mid-topic, append later related lessons to the same chapter.
